requirements.requirement: The system must render a PI credibility section within the clinical trial scorecard UI when PI data is present.
The system must display the investigator name as a primary label within the PI credibility section.
The system must display the investigator institution as a secondary label beneath or alongside the investigator name.
The system must display prior clinical trial count using formatted numeric text consistent with existing scorecard patterns.
The system must display a publication indicator using a visual cue (icon, badge, or label) aligned with chat UI design standards.
The system must display PI score contribution as a visually distinct element consistent with other score components in the trial scorecard.
The system must maintain visual hierarchy such that PI credibility appears as a subordinate section within the overall trial scorecard, not as a standalone message.
The system must align typography, spacing, and color usage of the PI section with existing MessageBubble UI patterns.
The system must support rendering the PI credibility section via either extension of MessageBubble or a reusable child component without breaking existing message rendering.
The system must conditionally hide individual PI fields (name, institution, trial count, publication indicator, score contribution) if those values are absent in the transformed data.
The system must render the PI section without layout breakage when one or more optional fields are missing.
The system must not render the PI credibility section at all if no PI data object is provided (exception path).
The system must display a neutral fallback label (e.g., "PI data unavailable") if a PI object exists but contains no displayable fields (exception path).
The system must render the PI credibility section within the same message container as the trial scorecard rather than creating a separate message bubble.
The system must ensure the PI credibility component is reusable by accepting props consistent with the S1 data contract and S2 transformed output.
